articles.summary: In the first contentious decisions issued by the Seabed Disputes Chamber under Part XI of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (“UNCLOS”), judges ruled unanimously to prescribe provisional measures to protect the rights of TMC’s subsidiaries, NORI and TOML, in their proceedings
articles.title: TMC Welcomes Unanimous Decisions by International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea Ordering the ISA to Respect NORI and TOML’s Due Process Rights
